description: Language-neutral cases for the Margins tab control center and arrival preview (part of #3216). SessionKit's MarginsControlCenterCasesTests runs every case; the web prototype can run the same file.

constants.missingParentNote: reply to a Margin you don't have

cases.note: The prototype's seed: two friends, a conversation of four under your 3:10 Margin, placeholder words, some heard. Threads by time, replies under their parent. At 13:00 the next Margin is your 15:30.

cases.note: Before the next Margin's 20 s lead-in, Next Margin seeks forward to the lead-in. Input is out of time order.
Inside a Margin's lead-in, Next Margin goes straight into that Margin: forward, never back to the lead-in's start, never past it to the next one.
Exactly at the lead-in's start the listener is inside it.
A Margin at the playhead is behind; the next one is the target.
At or after the last Margin there is no Next Margin.
The pill's countdown is an m:ss clock, rounded up so it never promises an early arrival: 5:27.4 reads 5:28.
Minutes keep counting past an hour: 62:05.
A Margin in the first 20 s leads in from 0:00, and at 0:00 the listener is already inside that lead-in.
Next Margin steps through every placed Margin, replies too: at 3:15 Sam's reply at 3:20 is 5 s ahead.

cases.note: An item with no Margins: nothing to list, skip to, or open on.
When every friend's Margin is heard the item opens on Now, and Start with unheard Margins has nowhere to go.
Your own Margins are neither heard nor unheard, so they never open the Margins tab.
Listening to any part (1 ms) marks a friend's Margin heard; reading it (0 ms listened) does not.
Autoplay All Margins: every Margin plays, yours and heard ones too.
Autoplay None: a tone marks every Margin, unheard ones too.
Blank, missing and placeholder words show as words coming; real words are trimmed.

cases.note: The row quotes the source text before the Margin with whitespace collapsed; past 110 characters it keeps the end, starts at a whole word and opens with an ellipsis. No text, no quote.

cases.note: Starring is for your own Margins to share; a friend's Margin never shows as starred.
A reply whose parent isn't in this Library starts its own thread and says so.

rows.note: reply to a Margin you don't have

cases.note: One friend's reply to another friend's Margin threads under it.
A Margin with no place in this copy lists after the placed ones, has no start point and is never the Next Margin target.
Two Margins at the same time list in the order they were made (the input lists Margins oldest first).
Start with unheard Margins begins at the lead-in of the first thread holding an unheard friend's Margin, the thread's first Margin, so a reply is heard after what it answers.
